context: Mathematics / College Algebra. No authored doc.md exists for this course; each lesson is grounded in its live topic list and its existing quiz bank (source.md).

topics: Equations with parentheses, decimals, and fractions
laterLessonsCover: 02 Graphs and forms of linear equations: Intercepts and Slope, Slope-intercept form, Point-slope form, and Standard form, Parallel and perpendicular lines

03 Functions: Recognizing functions from tables and graphs, Evaluating functions and function notation, Domain and range, Intervals (Positive/Negative, Increasing/Decreasing), Introduction to inverse functions
04 Quadratics Multiplying and factoring: Multiplying binomials and special products, Factoring quadratics (intro, grouping, difference of squares, perfect squares)

05 Quadratic functions and equations: Vertex form and features of quadratic graphs, Solving quadratics by square roots, factoring, and completing the square, The Quadratic Formula, Interpreting quadratic models
06 Complex numbers: The imaginary unit i, Adding, subtracting, and multiplying complex numbers, Complex conjugates and dividing complex numbers
07 Exponents and radicals: Exponent properties (integer exponents), Simplifying square-root expressions, Graphing exponential growth and decay
08 Rational expressions and equations: Reducing, multiplying, and dividing rational expressions, Adding and subtracting rational expressions, Solving rational equations and modeling
09 Relating algebra and geometry: Distance and Midpoint formulas, Standard and expanded equations of a circle
10 Polynomial arithmetic: Adding, subtracting, and factoring higher-degree polynomials, Average rate of change of polynomials
11 Advanced function types: Absolute value and piecewise functions, Composite functions, Verifying inverse functions
12 Transformations of functions: Shifting and reflecting functions, Scaling functions vertically, Symmetry (Even and Odd functions)
13 Rational exponents and radicals: Rational exponents and properties, Solving square-root and exponential equations
14 Logarithms: Introduction to logarithms and evaluation, Relationship between exponentials and logs, Properties of logarithms and Change of Base formula, Exponential model word problems
